p4_b0.ocr: In the context of Wipro's Professional & Business Services, the analysis of utilization rates by practice and project margin provides crucial insights into operational efficiency and profitability across various sectors. p4_b1.ocr: Additionally, the Finance sector showcases a utilization rate of 80%, generating a substantial revenue of £110K. Notably, the Human Resources practice, with a revenue of £15M, demonstrates a strong margin of 70% alongside a utilization rate of 85%. This indicates effective resource deployment within the practice.
